info.title: MyScoutee internal member directory reads
info.description: Existing canonical membership read API, with detached membership views and owner-controlled VIP eligibility. Dedicated service credential and mandatory REAL/DEMO. No delegated actor authority or member writes. Queries capped at 1 MiB, batches at 4096 IDs, IDs at 512 characters, pages at 1000 entries; responses capped at 2 MiB.
